title: This came in NUST NET 2023. Most get it wrong.
caption:
2¹⁰ = 1024. The maths is right. The answer is still wrong.

Scientific notation needs one digit before the decimal, then a power of ten. That makes it 1.024 × 10³. 2¹⁰ is the same number written the wrong way, and that is exactly why it catches people.

This one came up in NUST NET 2023.

NET 1 is on 17 November. Every question in Ustaad is from a real past paper, and every one comes with the reason behind the answer, not just a tick or a cross.
